verdict.rationale: Drata documents its own compliance-program building blocks: a Policy Center and policy versioning, controls with requirement mappings, frameworks and framework requirements, an evidence library, monitoring tests, and audits. Community reports confirm clients use Drata (and its agent) to run SOC 2 compliance, with noncompliance shown in the Drata dashboard. However, no first-party evidence explicitly names SOC 2 Type I vs Type II support, built-in Trust Services Criteria control sets, or pre-built SOC 2 policy templates. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of SOC 2 Type I and Type II workflows, prebuilt Trust Services Criteria control mappings, SOC 2 policy templates and auditor evidence-request handling, independent hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end SOC 2 audit.
